name: Heart no Clover
source:
This girl looks like me, surprisingly abandoned. Can I love such a girl? 

Theme of this love novel is "Eternal Promise".

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-december-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
这个女孩看起来像我，令人惊讶地被遗弃了。我可以爱这样的女孩吗？

这部爱情小说的主题是“永恒的约定”。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-december-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
